questions.question: Which of the following statements is NOT true?
questions.option_1: The government deals with fiscal policy.
questions.option_2: Fiscal policy is linked with general economic policy strategy of the country.
questions.option_3: Fiscal policy includes tax policy, expenditure policy, investment or disinvestment strategies and debt or surplus management.
questions.option_4: Fiscal policy deals with the supply of money in the economy and the rate of interest.
